label: Reason
resolution: Reason is read ontically (DEF-PSR-STRENGTH-REASON, a reason why a fact obtains) in every PSR, brute-truth and explained clause, and epistemically (DEF-EPISTEMIC-SUPPORT, a reason to accept a claim) in every supported, honored and demanded clause. The results do not pass from one to the other: the consistent critic has a supported brute root and an explained unsupported event. A passage from one to the other occurs only through a bridge listed as an explicit hypothesis (DEF-EPISTEMIC-ONTIC-BRIDGES).
